correctness.rationale: The positivity inequality (I-G)^2≤I-G² reduces the pair constraint to near-norming vectors. Compact injective defect makes these exactly weak-null unit sequences; finite-codimensional double-tail compressions yield the standard essential norm and numerical-radius half-bound, attained by infinite square-zero isometry. For every other nonzero defect, transfer from the kernel or arbitrarily low spectral band to a high spectral band gives p_G(T)=1 and v_G(T)=0. Infinite-dimensional noncompact injective case has infinite-dimensional low and high subspaces. Quantifiers and seminorm kernel are explicitly handled; the 35,409 supplementary finite checks are not used as infinite proofs.
